resolvedAttempts.name: focused-1817-initial
resolvedAttempts.reason: Initial test helper had a duplicate local variable declaration. Corrected newly added Orochi spec to use the native g179Other source-exclusion field rather than the unrelated generic other flag. Fixture corrections use Shauna actual printed9500, leave a sealed ignored creature in battle, put Senno on the relevant opposing side of the active library owner, and separate Onikamas free-entry bounce from the ordinary reveal test while testing its actual bounce in a dedicated case. Captured source-base UID before its physical under array is cleared on payment. Added the public inspection snapshot directly to queued Put/LookRest steps, since ordinary start context intentionally does not propagate arbitrary fields.
